name: God-Eternals
description: The undead gods Bolas brings through the portal: Oketra, Bontu, Rhonas, Kefnet and Hazoret.

description_citations.text: "War of the Spark (event)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Four God-Eternals emerge from the portal over Tenth District Plaza, and Samut identifies them as her plane's gods, now Bolas's servants.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: The God-Eternals tear apart Vitu-Ghazi, and Domri cheers and announces the Gruul will join the dragon.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Kaya recalls Vitu-Ghazi's dormancy after the God-Eternals' damage and sets out with Kellan.
timeline.quote: When last Kaya had seen Vitu-Ghazi, the great living guildhall had been dormant

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 5: Chains of Expectation
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 5: Chains of Expectation" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Bolas zombifies Bontu into a God-Eternal.
timeline.quote: Bontu was zombified by Nicol Bolas and transformed into one of the God-Eternals

citation.text: "Bontu", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The God-Eternals tear the animated tree apart; Rhonas rips off an arm and Nissa relinquishes control as it collapses.
timeline.quote: Rhonas tore out one of its arms

citation.text: "Vitu-Ghazi", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The God-Eternals destroy Vitu-Ghazi and the Boros troops retreat.
timeline.quote: The undead gods quickly destroy Vitu-Ghazi, tearing it to pieces.

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 1". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
